# Rule 4- Respect Admin Decisions [bold]Admin decisions are final[/bold]. If you are unsure of something and the rules do not make things clear, ask the admins via AHelp for a clarification.
The rules attempt to clearly communicate what is allowed and prohibited, but there are likely loopholes that can be "lawyered". Do not do this. Don't manipulate the interpretation of the rules to suit your personal goals or to degrade the experience of other players.
Above all else, if an admin instructs you to stop doing something, then [bold]stop immediately[/bold]. You may explain your point of view and your reasoning, but you must still follow what is requested of you even if you disagree.
## Admin Fallibility Admins are not omniscient or omnipresent. There are bound to be things that are missed, misunderstood, or miscommunicated. In the case of such, try to clarify your perspective and timeline of events rather than contest an action directly.
If you believe that a punishment, ruling, or other admin action was incorrect or unfair, you may bring the matter up via Discord. Keep in mind that the administration team is comprised of regular people too, and mistakes happen.
## Treatment Of Staff All admins and contributors, like the players, are volunteers freely giving their time to the server. Disagreements should not escalate to disrespect, and issues with administration or with server content should be handled civilly. Interactions with staff (both to and from) are under the regulations of [textlink="Rule 1" link="RuleSpL1"].
